test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On: 09 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been divided into four segments. Identify the segment that contains an error.

Mr. Abhilash and his family / have received / no informations / about the incident.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word** "informations" **is incorrect because **"information"** is an uncountable noun and does not have a plural form.
 
• Uncountable nouns typically do not end in **"s"** and are treated as singular.
 
• The correct phrase should be** "no information"** instead of **"no informations."**
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 2** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Mr. Abhilash and his family have received **no information** __about the incident."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **1) have received** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **3) about the incident.** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **4) Mr. Abhilash and his family** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
